lastCompletedStory.title: Implementer runs the gate at Layer A to self-correct

nextStoryContext: US-003 added the 'Behavioral gate (Layer A) — self-correction' section to both the runtime agent prompt (.claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md) and the cam-init template (templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md). The section instructs the implementer to call runBehavioralGate (src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts) for any tmux-drivable [oracle: ...] in acceptanceCriteria, fix-with-vision on failure, and explicitly states the Layer A run is self-correction only and NOT the artifact-of-record. Vendor was re-embedded (src/vendor/_generated.ts). The next story (US-004 or higher priority) can reference the behavioral gate machinery from US-002/US-003 as ready-to-use.
